author: REH.2.
title: Paying to remove ads makes the game worse
content:
I’ve been playing this game for months and genuinely enjoyed it, but FULLY REGRET buying the $9 “No Ads” option.

The ads in this game are tied to rewards, like getting a fourth box or earning extra points at the end of a level. When I paid $9 to remove ads, I assumed I was paying to remove the requirement to watch an ad to access those features, particularly the extra box. Instead, the rewards themselves disappeared along with the ads.

So rather than improving the game, paying $9 actually made the gameplay worse. I now have fewer boxes available and fewer opportunities to earn bonus points than I did before I paid.

If purchasing “No Ads” means forfeiting the rewards and gameplay features associated with those ads, that needs to be made VERY clear before purchase. Better yet, paying players should either receive those benefits without watching an ad or still have the option to voluntarily watch a rewarded ad.

I’ve also had issues with saving progress. I recently created an account after playing for months, and afterward the 5,000+ coins I had accumulated disappeared. Parts of the game also started giving me beginner tutorials again, despite the fact that I was still on level 500+.

This feels extremely deceptive and permanent, so that they can later charge you even more money to get more boxes. The game should make it clear before purchase that removing ads also removes access to the rewards tied to them.

You’re literally paying $9 for the pleasure of NOT being able to accrue more rewards during gameplay. Ridiculous.

It is frustrating however to be at level 260 ( hard level) and all of a sudden the game just turns off and takes you back to you phones home screen.   It has done this many times .  Last time I had almost finished the level so was t happy about it . 

Also sometimes when I tap on a screw, it takes a few taps.

author: d00dingt0n
title: Good game.
content: Enjoyed the game while I had it installed. It’s a simple puzzle game. The only reason I uninstalled it is because the ads were so invasive. Some of them were opening my browser. Which is just so skeezy and annoying. I’m not sure how much control the developer has on which ads show for the game (probably not much consider I got an ad for the very same game I was playing) but that was just too much. Game itself was great though. Do recommend.

author: SamGSS52
title: More options for power ups
content: I love this game, I never review things but this game is so fun. My only gripe is that at one point in time, you were able to watch ads to earn power ups without having to spend money. I wish they would bring that back. Also, the weekly tasks are gone, which was another way to win free power ups. I wish they would stop taking away the things that make harder levels accessible.

author: Penny4Thought
title: Loud annoying ads
content: This game has a banner ad that runs randomly WHILE you are playing the game and the sound of the ad is LOUD. So you’re playing the game and get scared out of your mind.  The only way to stop the sound is to turn the volume down on your phone all the way. Otherwise it’s a really fun game. I ended up deleting it because of this ad though. There are also multiple long ads that you have to sit through every time you win a level, every time you lose a level. Maybe offer a pay to play version without the ads.

author: Lausterscot
title: Gets Old Fast
content:
The game is fun, but you can’t get any meaningful coinage to buy perks. 10 a round you win, but a boost is over 400? 
Also, it gets boring when they never give you the color you need - like we get it. Y’all want to make money and keep trying until I buy the dumb package. But my time isn’t so invaluable that I’ll put up with such shenanigans once I reach the higher levels. 
The spatial design is nice, but so much zooming in and wiggling to spot connections between boxes is somewhat punishing. Feels like a job. 
I’ll keep the app, but I don’t think it’ll get much use.

author: Joejoeru
title: Game was good until excessive ads
content: This is the first review I ever wrote for a game because I am so mad. Why would you guys start putting ads during gameplay? It was perfectly fine when you guys had it after each level but now I can’t even focus on the gameplay because I’m so focused on these ads that keep switching every three seconds like how is this game supposed to be my peace when all I’m saying is ads, switching and taking away from my attention span for the gameplay

author: Elysian73
title: Fun but buggy
content: I’ve emailed them about this issue but the game will freeze sometimes and I have to restart my phone to get out of it. It’s incredibly frustrating, especially if you’ve gotten extra color boxes or used resources to help your gameplay- you just lose these items. They don’t come back if you go back into the level. I don’t know why they haven’t fixed this issue as it’s been persistent for over a year and others seem to be experiencing it as well.

author: MNMom22
title: Money hungry game
content: The game is fun and graphics are good, but….. I had played with ads but they were obnoxious, so I paid to play without them. Well now you can’t earn enough coins to really buy anything, so you have to pay to buy coins. Without the extras passing many of the levels, especially hard levels is near impossible. Well I noticed today that everything now costs even more coins then they did before. So I think it is time to call it quits on this game, as it is clear they are really setting you up to fail if you don’t spend money and buy coins to get tools to help you complete levels.

author: Mkh1712
title: Fun but borderline unusable
content: The levels are honestly not passable unless you use all the power ups or watch a million videos. After making a purchase, the option to watch videos goes away which seems wild. It feels like they made the game less playable when you spend money on it. It also starts with only two boxes and for majority of the levels, you literally cannot beat without at least 3 or 4. Visuals are great and it’s fun when you’re actually able to play. Also, when you press the “help and support” button, it takes you to an external app that just says page not available.

author: Self imposed zombie.
title: Loved until updates
content: I loved this game, it was so great to waste time, ads were bearable and I used to spend hours on it. Until updates changed the game entirely for me. Now we have lives and need to wait if we run out. I was so used to just leveling and just starting over between fails without waiting. Now I find myself in the app less and less because of that change. I hope one day it changes back but who knows.

author: Mc yeah
title: Great game but…
content: This is a great game and the best remove the screw game that I have found. One of the problems I have encountered is that it makes my phone incredibly hot especially after ads play. No other apps that I have do this. Another is that I will be almost done with a level and it will completely close the game back to my normal phone screen and it doesn’t save progress when it does that. I deleted the app even though I enjoy it due to the heating up my phone issue. Please fix this.

author: B de h ever hehd
title: It is pretty good
content: The game itself is fun but it can be annoying sometimes because sometimes you just can’t find enough nails and you fill up the dot things at the top which will make you rather spend 80 coins for another box or free but you have to watch ads or just start over again. Once I literally had to do it 5 times till I finally got to the next level. But it is quite fun and honestly satisfying.

author: Doesmt matter
title: Loved it at first, but it changed
content: I got this game recently after seeing ads for it and I have played it almost every day. It is so fun and it can involve some strategy so it’s a great game to sit and relax while playing. BUT…. The latest updates have caused my game to have a considerable amount of ads, and my phone over heats terribly after about 10 minutes and the game starts to glitch and the reaction time slows wayyy down. It is very disappointing because this has caused me to not play nearly as much as it ruins the game play. I don’t know how much I’ll keep playing if it continues this way.

author: dudelease
title: Made to lose
content: All the playable ads for this game always said something like “impossible to pass, been playing two hours and can’t pass” or you play the mini game on the ad and you never beat it… this was all foreshadowing. you’re meant to lose the game until you decide to spend money on it. they design it for you to lose, then then most of the levels aren’t even those cool little houses or animals. it’s ALWAYS the wooden planks screwed into each other, making it more of a fidget game, and if that’s your thing cool, but the ads shouldn’t have been so deceiving. wasted my time and lost my love for the game.

author: futurehilbert
title: Fun but…
content: Game is fun and I enjoy the challenging levels however it never seems to fail as soon as I’m close to beating a challenging level the game rage quits. When you reopen it, you have to start all over again, which would be fine except for the fact that if you use any tools or any coins that you’ve built up to pass the level, you lose it all. There’s nothing more frustrating than having your hard earned tools or coins become null & void due to a system failure.

author: SparrowNR
title: Useless 5th peg
content: Why do ALL the “unscrew” games have a useless last hole? Either make it so that it doesn’t auto-fail you when you fill it, since you might have freed up the peg you need, or HIDE THE HOLE in the interface. It’s SUCH a bad user experience to see there’s a hole present and know that if you use it, you lose the level automatically, even if you would have had moves afterward. That’s counter to what those holes are supposed to be for. Deleting this game and finding one that doesn’t do that BS.

author: jenniferusa
title: Do not buy credits
content: This is the most buggy app I’ve ever used. It freezes. You buy credits and it freezes and the progress you make goes away. But so does your credit. You basically have to buy credits because from early on the game is unbeatable early on. Most puzzle games are progressively difficult. This one is built for you to just spend credits.

author: angdevwriter
title: Needs a ‘Back’ Button
content:
I really enjoy this game, but it’s annoying when you accidentally tap a different screw than intended (some of us have bigger fingers than others). Even if it only goes back one step, it helps get through the game. ESPECIALLY since the ad-free game takes away any opportunities to earn.

Additionally, why does the last extra space automatically end the game? Why can’t we fill all the spaces and then end the game if a 6th screw gets added? It’s starting to feel like those who have the ad-free experience have less opportunities.

author: pacha papi
title: Pay to play don’t download
content:
Game is good until you get to higher levels. Literally impossible to beat some levels without paying money. Don’t pay for the game that way you can get free ad watch passes. This game would be so amazing if they weren’t greedy. So many matches where they only select colors that are at the very end so it will not allow me to win. PAY TO PLAY should be in this games description. I’m don’t giving money

It’s literally like a smoking addiction. Nothing good comes out of this game other than you getting very disappointed once you get to higher levels. Addictive and forces you to spend money

author: Schaufs
title: Love game but issue after purchasing No Ads
content:
I like the game a lot. There is something very satisfying about it.
I purchased ‘No Ads’ thinking it would remove the mandatory ads between games but still allow me to choose to watch an ad to get a new screw bucket when I’m stuck. This is not the case! It forces me to buy a new screw bucket instead! This feels like a punishment. Please fix so that buying no ads removes the mandatory ads but still allows you to choose to watch an add to get an extra screw bucket.

author: Xanbo12
title: Disappointed Now
content: Disappointed to pay $10 yesterday for the ad free experience just delete today… So much fun at first. Too many ads, often duplicate ads for one perk or whatever, and the frequent ad scam link to virus website started popping up a lot which was a concern. I still opted to pay $10 for an ad free experience. Once you’ve done that you MUST pay to play from then on. I’m about 100 levels in and you can no longer open another color to unscrew and my little helping tools are tapped out. Pay to play, or delete. DELETE!

author: Crgbbtrshiib4678
title: Users: Keep ads!
content: I regret paying to remove ads because once you do, you have to pay for everything.  I would much rather watch ads (or gate the option to) to get extra boxes or tools than to have to keep giving this app money. *The game makers * need to redo offer more free tools/coins for those who’ve already paid- the reward system is way off!   I’ve spent more than enough money on this game I’m stuck at a level and refused to pay more money so the game is useless to me now.

author: N!ck#@m&
title: Great game, rip off price
content: DO NOT PAY TO REMOVE ADS!!!! Ok, now that is out of the way, I loved this game before paying to remove ads. I normally play something for a while and then I will pay to support them if I like it. In this case, that was a huge mistake. I’ve been stuck on the same level waiting for sheer luck since the purchase. Once you spend money, they just want you to spend more. Play with the ads, and you’ll enjoy it, DO NOT pay to remove them unless you just want to keep spending.

author: JessEmily18
title: Was great but ruined by life feature
content: I’ve downloaded tons of these games and thought this was my favorite. Cute graphics, the ability to zoom and especially to see through the blocks. I loved it but the addition of a life feature ruins it. Some of the puzzles are hard and also luck is a factor so it takes many tries to pass. The lives means I can only play this game for short stints at a time. I was going to pay for no ads but I won’t now because it’s not worth it anymore

author: pynk_debt
title: Coins for everything?
content: It’s a fun and addicting game and stuff but seriously like I swear some of the boxes won’t give you the color you need ON PURPOSE so you have to watch an ad to get the tool and finish the level. Plus they made everything more expensive so the tools cost even more, it takes away from the fun of a game if I have to watch multiple ads in between each level. Plus it doesn’t even save your level after you leave the app. My app will literally refresh and my level will be gone and I have to restart, it’s genuinely annoying.

author: Jordan Rosen
title: Fun but…
content: The game itself is very fun. The problem is that it is designed to make money and as much as possible. Many levels are impossible to beat without  special moves that cost actual money. You can pay a premium to remove ads but you aren’t really treated like just spent $10 for a game. There are premium mobile games that cost less to buy that give you a better value. Unfortunately, my review is irrelevant because the game is addictive and people want the rush of winning.

author: Ltforlife
title: Fun game. Ads ruin it
content: This is a very fun game. Probably one of the better screw removal games as it is difficult enough to challenge, but not so hard as to be impossible. I enjoyed it, but the ads killed it for me. I understand the purpose of ads, it’s how the game can be free to play. My issue is the abuse of ads that the companies have allowed. It wasn’t that long ago, a 20 second ad was the norm. Now the big ads like the Royal Match travesty are taking over a minute and a half to get through. That’s ridiculous. I’m done. Ap is deleted. Thanks for a good game, but get better advertisers.

author: bobcooley
title: Trying to hijack my browser and display ads constantly
content:
When just playing the game, not touching any of the banner ads, the game constantly keeps opening my web browser and delivering Shien ads. 

Even when you’re quick enough to stop the browser from opening, it’s still opens the webpage in the background, so when I did finally open my browser, I found I had at least 30 pages of the same ad over. 

This game seems to be forcing clicks to increase its revenue, and it makes the game almost unplayable.

author: Gajfiks
title: Mid tools
content: The reason I’m giving it’s a 3 stars is because of the fact that you are only given 2 screw boxes for every level and is not possible to beat with 2 from my experience and you are forced to watch ads to unlock more as well as the ads after every level it gets really annoying after you watch 2-3  1m30sec ads then When you finally beat the level your hit with another 30sec ad I’d fix those issues and then you will have a good game that ppl won’t get bored of. I’m hoping these issues get fixed.

author: JamCran
title: Forces You to Shein Website
content: While ads are always annoying, this game now randomly forces you to Shein’s website randomly while playing. The game will automatically switch to Shein (on safari) multiple times while I’m in the middle of playing a level. Annoying enough for me to delete the app.

author: ddc444
title: UI is obnoxious...
content: I enjoy playing this game (even tho sometimes the AI will purposefully give you colors it knows you can't reach), but the user interface is extremely aggravating. First, you open the app, and you have to click out of SO many pop ups for events and bonus games. I counted 7 pop ups in a row once. Some of them take you straight to a minigame and forces you to complete a tutorial before you can exit. I just want to play the normal levels!! If I wanted to play a special event, I would click on the event! They'll even show the pop ups after you finish each level. There's no escape. Also, once you're in a level, the camera angles are super weird and it's hard to rotate. Some shapes will rotate to where you can barely even reach the screws because they're off screen. I also HATE the auto-rotate feature when you're idle for a few seconds. I would love to be able to turn that off. I don't want to be focusing or thinking about my next move and the whole screen just starts rotating. Lastly, they keep saying they removed the Shein ads that pop up at the bottom and automatically open up a browser, but then they always come back eventually with exactly the same issue. Just stop letting Shein advertise on your game at this point, c'mon.

author: Lauramac1625
title: Too many ads
content: I really like this game, and then several levels in the ads start. They go on forever and don’t have a time limit. And then around level 80 they just start popping up during gameplay. Too much. I’m deleting

author: NanoFin96
title: Intrusive Ads
content: This game was wonderful until you added video ads that pop up in your face in the MIDDLE OF A PUZZLE. I’m not sure how much worse that is than the obnoxious ad audio that suddenly plays randomly throughout the puzzle, interrupting the nice and peaceful music. What was once a relaxing game is making me angry.

author: Unhappycustomer4849
title: Ads Mid Game!
content: When you get to level 178 ads will pop up mid game, which ruins it. Now I’m deleting it due to that.

author: Krissyo78
title: Ads Ruined a Great Game
content: I dealt with having to sit through long ads that crashed the game and lost all progress, trying to get boosts. But the loud ad banners at the bottom during regular gameplay are a deal breaker. Unplayable now.

author: Camlanar
title: Good for boredom
content: This game is very fun I use it often when I’m bored. Only downside is that even if you turn off music or the noise there is still music playing, and it’s random it’ll play and then stop playing. I believe it’s due to glitches as often after the music a message pops up saying something went wrong try again. But other than glitches and the annoying adds I think it’s equally challenging and fun for an app.

author: Zerorugrats
title: Fun until ….
content: Fun until level 15, then ads constantly running on the bottom of the page and you can’t mute them. Deleting this app.

author: LA2666
title: Audio ads took the fun away
content: I love this game and was fine with the ads incorporated but all the sudden the banner ads started playing audio out of the blue meaning I can’t listen to my audiobook while playing.

author: Leacher20
title: Coins vs amount of extra
content: The coins you get per level compared to what they want to unlock the extra per level is crazy. I got the extra box early on thinking it would be there for the next levels as well but nope, goes away next level. Only 10 coins per level unless watch an ad and they want 250 to unlock stuff

author: StephieDB
title: Video ads ruin this game
content: This game is my favorite but recently the video ads are so loud and distracting I’m considering deleting and not using this game.

author: Emeraldjules71
title: Frustration
content: Game is fun and stress relieving but…. Every level seems to be either hard or super hard, no relief time or winning. Also, if you fill up the screw bank it automatically ends the game which I understand but… if you still have a move when that happens, it shouldn’t end until there are no moves

author: BelMeek
title: Levels are way too hard for no reason
content: Every single level as been almost impossible to beat unless u spend money. Gettjng rather annoyed by it

author: SamanthaS
title: Game has become unplayable
content: I used to love this! The recent addition of the terrible screaming gambling adds (that you can not mute) and play on top of the background music, during gameplay have made this game essentially unplayable. I cannot play something and listen to the AI gambling scams in the background. I liked the music. I didnt mind and could deal with all the other common grievances, I am on like level 1600, this was my go to chill game.  Im deleting it now.

author: Honestreviewer54
title: Locks phone screen
content: As others have said the game will freeze suddenly. Nbd except it freezes your whole phone-you can’t leave the app, can’t hit button to turn screen off. Only option is hard reset and that still takes multiple attempts. Makes me concerned about what’s running on the backend

author: Shay090
title: Upset
content: Too many ads playing in the background! I only play this game when I’m listening to my audiobook and all I hear is  ads .. 1 every 3 seconds constantly!!! And some are  louder than what I’m listening to!! so upset.. I see there’s an update.. I’ll try it and if there’s still ads I’m deleting it!

author: HoneyBeeMae
title: It’s gotten so terrible
content: I used to be able to play with headphones in, but now if I’m listening to something, the ads at the bottom of the screen play at the loudest possible volume. I hate that I can’t play this anymore, it used to be so soothing

author: Aheslop
title: Terrible Game
content: You can’t pass level 5 without paying for a booster. Game ends if the reserve line fills even if you reveal a color that would go into the top 2 boxes.

author: B.elf
title: Great Game, Loud Ads
content: At first I loved this game. It’s just challenging enough to keep you entertained without feeling impossible. However, whatever newer update they had added extremely loud ads that scroll across the bottom that you can’t silence or turn down; and you do get the sound to go away, 3 seconds later, another one pops up. I didn’t mind all of the ads that happened after you finish the game or if you wanted an extra tile to continue playing, but these are just obnoxious. I like to listen to youtube or music while I play, but these new ads are extremely annoying and I just can’t tolerate playing it anymore. Hopefully they change it soon and I’m going to keep it in hopes that they do; but if they don’t, I’ll just delete it and try a different one. I’m just happy I didn’t pay for no ads yet because someone else I know that plays says they still pop up.

author: talex5555
title: Ridiculous Loud Video Ads
content: I liked this game a lot, but it’s recently started playing video ads at the bottom of the screen that are insanely loud. I don’t know why they thought that would make people pay to rid of them when there are similar apps that have no ads at all - FOR FREE. author: ajrenni

author: Patrick C. O.

author: KatApp1e

author: MauMau25
title: Fun BUT
content: Game is fun But it has an insane amount of ads! Would have been nice if the game offers a paid version to get rid of the ads.

author: Cats-fan

author: Mary01010101

author: KNLmomx2

author: Sun💫⭐️🌟⭐️⭐️💫⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Jaqq
title: Loud ads

author: spaceman537
title: Fun but buying pro breaks it
content: I loved being able to just click watch an ad for a free spot but was annoyed with ads after I finished each puzzle. author: McDonaugh04

author: jbarlis

author: Opbrat

content: Good game I enjoy it but I’m usually listening to music or an audible book and the ads at the bottom of the screen suddenly start playing over the game and it’s annoying.

author: MoniMoni823
title: Forces you to pay to progress

author: Mr Yozhik
title: Obnoxious Ads
content: It’ll play ads during gameplay, very annoying. Skip it.

author: LadyCal03
title: Fun but lots of drawbacks
content: It’s very addicting and a good time-waster. author: timbosliceeeee

author: nadsboys

author: tpico93

content: Not sure why the ads now play sound during gameplay. It’s pretty annoying. Other than that I very much enjoy playing this game. Hoping this gets fixed as the ads never had sound to them before.

author: gwyneth c

content:

author: JR3014

author: InoYs

author: AmND18
